selection_rule: Three outcome-selected Basic test illustrations in which the current unified NanoJev succeeds and both comparison policies fail. The examples cover a far-right target, a far-left target and a smaller rightward correction. They are selected illustrations, not an estimate of aggregate performance. All 128 test and 128 OOD episodes are reported separately.

cases.title: Cross the sightline
cases.description: The target starts far to the right. NanoJev strafes into position and eliminates it; Jev and Untuned Qwen reach the deadline without a hit.

cases.title: Find the left opening
cases.description: NanoJev moves toward the far-left target and lands the shot. Both comparison policies finish without an elimination.

cases.title: Adjust, then finish
cases.description: A smaller rightward correction lets NanoJev eliminate the target. Jev and Untuned Qwen miss this seed.
